main.description: Fulfillment policy set evaluated by a remote policy engine. The evaluator signs a service-auth JWT and calls com.publicdomainrelay.temp.market.evaluatePolicy on the engine, passing each policy name and its arguments. Carries downstream through subcontracting chains.

policies.description: Named policies for the engine to run; all must allow.

policyEngine.description: DID of the policy engine that evaluates this policy (for example did:web:engine.example.com).

requesterDid.description: ATProto DID of the root requester this policy set was minted for.

name.description: Name of the policy for the engine to run. Engines resolve this against the same registry used for local execution.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this policy admits.

args.description: Arguments passed to the policy at evaluation time. Well-known keys: bidWindowSec, firstFree.
